clips.caption:
He found over a hundred people in their late 90s with no drugs, no surgery and no health problems.

For his best-selling natural health book, Kevin Trudeau travelled the world looking for the one thing they all had in common.

One drank a gallon of milk a day. One smoked unfiltered cigarettes. One was climbing trees in the Amazon in his 90s.

The only pattern: food grown locally and eaten in season, and fermented food the rest of the year. Not one of them was taking supplements.

So he decided to just eat real food, and fill the gaps with whole food.

ep_v5j6eqp.note: 2026-10-16 - 'Pay Attention To The Chemicals In Your Water' (Rumble v5j6eqp). Weekly agent, WB health lane.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells a story about being a kid who did dumb things: eating dirt, chewing on a styrofoam cup.

His mother yelled every single time, hard enough that one day he cried and told her, "You just like being mean."

She said it would be a lot easier on her if she didn't care.

Years later, a friend's mother never once raised her voice. That friend cried too, for the opposite reason: "My mother doesn't care about me."

The lesson Kevin took from it: the parent correcting you is the one paying attention.

#kevintrudeau #selfimage #mindset #parenting #confidence #wbdaily

ep_v5j1oyl.note: 2026-10-17 - 'The Dark Side Of Vitamins And Supplements' (Rumble v5j1oyl). Weekly agent, WB health lane.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says real vitamin E isn't one single ingredient - it's a family.

His example: years ago, scientists made a lab version of vitamin E called D-alpha-tocopherol and sold it as the real thing. Later, researchers who studied whole foods like walnuts found that natural vitamin E is actually made of four different tocopherols, working together.

Kevin's point: a single synthetic tocopherol isn't the same as what nature packs into a walnut or a seed.

Next time you pick up a vitamin E bottle, look for 'mixed tocopherols' on the label, not just one name.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #vitamine #readthelabel #wholefoods #healthtruth

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to research on black plastic: the kind used in takeout containers, kitchen utensils, and the trays under your grocery store meat and sushi.

That black color often comes from recycled electronics plastic, carrying flame retardants never meant to touch food. Testing has found tiny plastic particles turning up in brain and fat tissue.

Kevin's advice: skip the black plastic. Ask for paper, choose glass or stainless for leftovers, and move food off black trays before you store or reheat it.

Kevin Trudeau says most blood pressure checks get the number wrong before they even start.

His point: articles he's read show the majority of these tests are done with the arm in the wrong position, which gives a falsely high reading. So the first question isn't what your number means, it's whether the test was done right.

His own habit: he keeps a blood pressure cuff at home and checks it himself from time to time, instead of relying on one office visit.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's view on cholesterol goes against what most people assume.

His explanation: LDL cholesterol doesn't attack your arteries on its own. It responds to damage that's already there, patching small tears in the artery wall so it can't rupture. That's his answer to a real puzzle: some people with very high cholesterol counts have wide-open arteries, and some with low counts still get blockages.

His take: the number alone never told the whole story. What's happening to the artery does.

What do you think matters more, the count or the damage?

#kevintrudeau #cholesterol #hearthealth #healthtruth #wbdaily #naturalhealth

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points out that "vegan" doesn't automatically mean healthy.

A vegan pizza, vegan chips, and vegan frozen dinners can be just as ultra-processed as anything else in the store. By his estimate, a lot of what plant-based eaters put in their cart falls into that category.

His point: whole fruits and vegetables are genuinely good for you. The ultra-processed versions built around them are a different thing entirely.

Next grocery trip, flip the package over before the word "vegan" decides it for you, and see how many ingredients you don't recognize.

#kevintrudeau #realfood #veganfood #readthelabel #wbdaily #healthtruth
